name: sap-scrubbing
description: SAP Scrubbing MCP — Harmony + DCD servers para uso com Joule Desktop e Claude Code

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:servers
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=mcp-utils && npm run build --workspace=mcp-logger && npm run build --workspace=sap-auth
scripts.build:servers: npm run build --workspace=sap-harmony-mcp && npm run build --workspace=sap-dcd-mcp
